# Code review signal

Prioritize functional correctness, reliability, compatibility, tests, and maintainability.

Do not report purely editorial spelling, grammar, punctuation, wording, or style issues in human-readable prose such as documentation, Markdown, README files, comments, or docstrings unless the issue materially changes technical meaning, correctness, user behavior, or a binding instruction.

Continue to report typos or text mistakes in executable or machine-significant content when they can affect behavior, including identifiers, string constants, paths, configuration keys, API fields, commands, selectors, protocol values, and similar literals.
